verdict.rationale: Restate's AI patterns documentation has a streaming-responses pattern stating it can stream updates from Restate Services to the UI via Server-Sent Events, and a separate pattern covers calling agents from frontends like Next.js and React. The evidence is a single summary line, so the mechanism, its durability and whether it carries token-level output are not shown. Missing for 10: detail on token-level LLM streaming versus step updates, how the SSE stream behaves across retries or recovery, SDK/API reference for the streaming mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I stream live progress — step updates or model tokens — from a running workflow into my frontend as it executes
